method_selected_note: Single change vs incumbent production: AR x R05 overlay combine operator product -> min (max-cash, non-compounding). risk_weight_AR_R05(t) = min(beta_AR(t), beta_R05(t)) replaces beta_AR(t) x beta_R05(t). M4 BOCPD overlay (m4_weight_lag) kept multiplicative in BOTH arms (orthogonal to AR/R05 combine; A/B isolates the single change). base sleeve selection / EW-Iter31-tilt / each beta's own derivation = STR_1715 forward_weights.R unchanged. NOT MVO/HRP/CVaR/ERC weight-search — this is a regime cash-scaling combine-operator design (sizing_only); Sigma is inherited and NOT MVO-consumed (STR_1715 = EW top-N + regime overlay).
selection_objective_note: sizing_only single-change A/B. The arm is NOT selected by net_ir maximization at optimizer stage (forge is authoritative for realized net_ir / SR / MDD). Objective framing = turnover-adjusted active return: max-cash reduces compound over-defense drag (intended to raise net active return in co-firing months) while keeping turnover floor (min vs product changes beta scalar only, not name selection -> no extra name turnover; only |delta invested| cash-leg turnover differs). Raw-Sharpe-max not used.
expected_tracking_error_basis: ex-ante sqrt(w' Sigma w) * sqrt(12), inherited 18x18 Ledoit-Wolf Sigma (stage_artifacts/WT_WT_S20260626_001/covariance.parquet, 2026-05-01 holdings basis). Representative month = 2026-03 (best Sigma-universe overlap: 15/18 names, invested_maxcash 0.85). Benchmark active weight ~0 on these concentrated active names (25-stock long-only book). NOT realized TE -- realized performance is forge-authoritative (measurement-graduation 1/2). Label = estimated.

expected_tracking_error_divergence_month.note: At an AR&R05 co-firing month, max-cash holds more risk (invested 0.560 vs mult 0.476) -> higher ex-ante TE (1.50% vs 1.27%). Confirms mechanism: max-cash trades over-defense drag for exposure/TE. Low overlap (4 names) since Sigma fixed to 2026-05 holdings -- headline 5.12% from 15-name month is representative.

combine_spec.incumbent_operator: invested(t) = m4_weight_lag(t) * beta_AR(t) * beta_R05(t)  [AR x R05 = product]
combine_spec.maxcash_operator: invested(t) = m4_weight_lag(t) * min(beta_AR(t), beta_R05(t))  [AR x R05 = min, non-compounding]
combine_spec.beta_R05_source: period_returns_layer5.csv::beta_R05_V5 (PIT lag-1, in {0.3,0.5,0.7,0.85,1.0}) -- production-admit V5 regime x R05_z interaction variant
combine_spec.m4_source: period_returns_layer5.csv::m4_weight_lag (PIT lag-1, continuous) -- M4 BOCPD schedule, kept multiplicative in both arms
combine_spec.base_sleeve_source: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010/alpha_scores.parquet::score_eff -> liq top-20 -> Iter31 linear tilt (lambda=1.5, cap 0.20). Unchanged from STR_1715.
combine_spec.pit: min(beta_AR, beta_R05) of two t-1 lagged values preserves PIT (min of two PIT values is PIT). No look-ahead introduced by the operator change.
combine_spec.ar_r05_divergence: min != product only when BOTH beta_AR<1 AND beta_R05<1 (co-firing). 32/269 months. Otherwise identical (one beta=1.0 -> min=product).

incumbent_vs_maxcash_summary.interpretation: In 32 co-firing months max-cash holds on average 10.66pp MORE risky exposure (less cash) than multiplicative incumbent -- removing the double-counted (compound) de-risk flagged by architecture audit B2 (M4<->AR overlap 91%). In 237 months arms are byte-identical. invested_maxcash range [0.227,1.000] vs invested_mult range [0.091,1.000] -- product can drive invested as low as 0.091 (deep compound de-risk), min floors deeper single de-risk only.
incumbent_vs_maxcash_summary.directional_caveat: max-cash is LESS defensive in co-firing months. Whether this nets positive (over-defense drag removed) or negative (weaker deep-crash defense in genuine co-crisis) is UNKNOWN at optimizer stage -- forge A/B realized MDD/CVaR/IR is authoritative. No performance guess (answer-principles).
